name_ar: تدقيق جدوى تعدد الوكلاء مقابل وكيل واحد
name_en: Audit multi-agent topology against single-agent baseline
what: عدّ حدود السياق بين الوكلاء في سير عمل متعدد، وتسعير ما يضيع عند كل حد مقابل ما يكسبه، والتوصية بإلغاء أي حد يتفوق عليه وكيل واحد قادر. — Count the context boundaries in a multi-agent workflow, price what each one loses, compare with what it buys, and recommend collapsing any boundary that a single capable agent would beat.
when: Before adding another agent or phase; a workflow is slow and nobody knows which part earns its time; agents keep agreeing; a handoff keeps losing information; post-mortem of a bad multi-agent result.
how: 1) List every point where context crosses between agents, including human to first agent and last agent to human; count crossings, not agents. 2) For each crossing note only the costs that apply: restating tokens and latency, handoff gaps, compression loss from free-text summaries, semantic drift, verification burden, governance waits. 3) Name what the boundary buys: real specialization, true wall-clock parallelism, cross-vendor diversity, or an adversarial reviewer whose disagreement is the product. 4) Compare with the single-expert baseline; the burden of proof is on the boundary; no gain term means collapse. 5) Label output prediction (described) or measurement (transcript).
params: workflow description or transcript; agent roster; what passes between agents

name_ar: تقييم DCF متين مع فحوص تقاطعية
name_en: Defensible DCF valuation with cross-checks
what: يبني تقييم تدفقات نقدية مخصومة بفترة توقع صريحة وقيمة نهائية بطريقتين وحساسيات. — Build a discounted-cash-flow valuation with explicit projection, both terminal-value methods, WACC build and sensitivities.
when: Pre-investment, M&A diligence, 409A, impairment, board valuation discussion.
how: 1) Project 5-10 years until steady state (extend if margins/growth still moving). 2) Terminal value both ways: Gordon FCF(N+1)/(WACC-g) and exit EBITDA multiple; compare. 3) Smell test: TV over ~75% of EV means short horizon or high g. 4) Build WACC from comparable betas, risk-free, ERP, size premium. 5) Bridge EV to equity (net debt, minorities, options). 6) Sensitivity grid plus scenario weights; cross-check against trading/precedent multiples.
params: company financials, WACC inputs, g, exit multiple

name_en: Cost-per-task model routing ladder
what: توجيه الطلبات لأرخص نموذج كافٍ بمصنف فرز وتصعيد عند عدم اليقين. — Route requests to the cheapest adequate model via a triage classifier with escalation.
when: Spend is high, Opus-for-everything policy, or mixed latency needs.
how: 1) Define simple/medium/complex tiers per domain. 2) Cheap-model triage call returning only a tier label; cache by request hash. 3) Handlers per tier; escalate on uncertainty signals. 4) Track cost-per-resolved-task, not per call. 5) Compare vendors with a task-shape cost table and set budget alerts.

name_en: LLM cost audit and routing
what: خفض تكلفة LLM عبر تسجيل التكلفة وتوزيع النماذج على طبقات والتخزين المؤقت وضغط الرموز. — Cut LLM spend 40-80% by logging per-request cost, tiering models, caching and compressing tokens.
when: Costs are high, an AI feature is launching, or model choice is open.
how: 1) Classify mode: audit, optimize, or design. 2) Log model, in/out tokens, latency, feature, cost per request. 3) Find top endpoints by feature x model x tokens. 4) Route simple/medium/complex tasks to small/mid/large tiers. 5) Add prompt caching and compression. 6) Monitor continuously; logging comes before optimization.

name_en: AML program review against FATF/FFIEC
what: مراجعة برنامج AML عبر الركائز الخمس بمستويات التصميم والتنفيذ والفعالية. — Review an AML program across five pillars at design, implementation and effectiveness levels.
when: Audit of AML/KYC controls or regulator readiness.
how: 1) Check five pillars: AML officer, policies/controls, training, independent testing, CDD/beneficial ownership. 2) For each pillar assess design, implementation, effectiveness separately. 3) List findings by frequency with primary-source citations. 4) Structured report with remediation.

name_en: Small-business margin and mix diagnostics
what: قراءة الهامش لكل ساعة وسلة المبيعات وسعة التشغيل لأنشطة خدمية. — Read margin per provider-hour, basket, attach and capacity for retail, spa, funeral, pharmacy operations.
when: Owner asks to lift profit in a regulated local business.
how: 1) Compute revenue and margin per service or room hour. 2) Tilt mix to high contribution. 3) Model device payback on realistic volume. 4) Find gating stage in case pipeline and size staffing. 5) Route clinical judgment to professionals.
